request_authority_exact_text: 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여
independence: Only requester envelope, assignment, exact skills, neutral pre-core controls/catalog, supplied photograph and general knowledge were used. No DATA, other arm, existing prompt or research was read.
brief: A full-length invited photographic portrait of a fictional adult ceramic maker during a playful pause after glazing; the workbench sits behind and to her side so both bare hands under her chin and both shoes on the workshop floor are unobstructed. One fully closed wink, the other eye open, flower-hand chin contact, a grounded one-heel lift, and defocused warm background lamps must remain simultaneously observable.
reference_scope: Visible facial appearance and short dark bob only, without any real identity, age, personality or health claim.

criteria.obligation: Short dark bob with loose fringe and generally reference-consistent visible facial appearance. Face is inspectable in original pixels; this is outward appearance review, not identity proof.

Both hands visibly belong to the subject, wrists close together beneath the chin, upturned palms/palm heels lightly contact the underside of the chin, and fingers fan outward beneath the cheeks. All hand-to-chin contact and wrist continuity must be visible; cheek-only framing fails.
Exactly one eyelid pair fully meets in a wink and the other eye remains visibly open toward the camera. Two narrowed eyes or two closed eyes fail.
One heel has an observable gap above the floor while that foot's ball/toes contact the floor; the other foot is flat and supports the standing body. Both shoes and contact/gap are inspectable.
Distant warm shelf-light sources form distinct soft circular defocus discs behind a substantially sharper face-and-hands subject plane.

Visible scarred wooden workshop bench, damp porcelain cup forms on a pale plaster bat, and a jade-glaze test tile with nearby brush establish the independent atelier setting and prior glazing activity.
Ochre knit vest, rolled ivory cuffs exposing wrists/hands and clay-marked indigo waist apron are visible with photographic material behavior.
Soft broad window illumination gives gentle transitions across face and hands while the distant lamps remain secondary.
One coherent full-body frame simultaneously exposes face, both hands with chin contact, and both shoes with floor relationship; no criterion is inferred through occlusion.

background_action_material_light_spatial: Glazing traces on work apron and damp ceramic surfaces
Scarred wooden bench behind/to the side of the standing subject
Pale plaster bat supporting porcelain cups
Jade glaze test tile and brush on workbench
Ochre knit versus indigo canvas and ivory shirt materials
Soft frosted-window illumination with distant warm shelf lamps
Feet and hands exposed within one full-length portrait frame
overall_rule: partial_is_fail; every agent testcase criterion and every actual pack-required/selected-opt-in gate must PASS. BLOCKED_UNSCORED is reserved for generation/tool block.
